claim_boundary: This is a paired comparison at seed 0 only; it does not provide mean or standard deviation across seeds.
It tests the selected reach-wall-v3 task and does not reproduce paper-scale multi-task success rates.
The observed 50% versus 30% success rates are run-specific evidence, not proof that one target semantic is generally superior.
All episodes intentionally run to the 200-step cap; success_steps counts successful observations and is not an early-stop time.

normalization.note: The downloaded comparison JSON was normalized only for whitespace and line wrapping before committing.
